summary: Batch 3a Replenishment Suggestions — full backend + UI regression. Backend pytest: 4 passed / 2 skipped (both skips are env-data driven, not code bugs). UI: Replenishment tab renders under /admin/inventory with 5 bucket tabs (Suggested/Approved/Dispatched/Received/Cancelled) + counts, Auto-generate button fires and toast displays correctly, Received bucket shows 2 rows (existing smoke `rep_601657ec72ed4136` + new TEST_manual Baguette Tradition rep). Full lifecycle approve → mark-received verified via API: status transitions correctly, receive stock movement is written (kind=receive, reason='Replenishment received (auto)', reference=replenishment:{id}), PartnerInventory.available_qty incremented by approved_qty, and movement_id is populated back on the replenishment row. Duplicate active suggestion returns 409 (unique partial index). Illegal transitions (received→approved, cancelled→received) return 409 as designed.

minor.issue: No low-stock or OOS inventory exists in current env (LOW STOCK=0, OUT OF STOCK=0 on the Control Tower KPIs). Auto-generate returns created=0, scanned=0 — so we could not exercise the `Suggested` bucket end-to-end in UI. Recommend seeding at least one low-stock SKU for durable regression coverage.

action_items: (Optional / low priority) Seed one Low-Stock SKU (available_qty <= low_stock_threshold, > 0) and one Out-of-Stock SKU in the demo dataset so that (a) the Suggested bucket has content, (b) UI quick-add `+ Restock` button on Low/OOS rows can be regression-tested end-to-end, and (c) auto-generate → approve → dispatch → receive can be exercised without an admin having to manually build state.
critical_code_review_comments: auto_generate() catches Exception from session.flush() but calls await session.rollback() inside the loop — with async SQLAlchemy this rolls back the *entire* transaction (including previously successfully-flushed rows), so a single unique-constraint violation would nuke the whole batch. In practice we short-circuit via `live_keys` so this rarely fires, but it's a latent correctness bug. Suggest using `session.begin_nested()` (SAVEPOINT) per row.

In _transition() for `new_status == 'received'`, `pp.stock_qty = inv.available_qty` sets the partner_product row's stock_qty to the *single-warehouse* inventory total, which is fine when a SKU lives in one store, but WILL desync when a SKU has multiple PartnerInventory rows (multi-warehouse). Consider recomputing pp.stock_qty as SUM(available_qty) across all warehouses on receive.
GET /admin/replenishments does not filter buckets by `country` — buckets counts are global even when country filter is applied to items list. Minor UX inconsistency.

success_rate.backend: 100% of runnable tests (4/4 passed, 2 skipped due to env data)
success_rate.frontend: 100% for verifiable flows (queue view, tabs, auto-gen, received bucket)
